column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:parse module (custom parsers)
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# aql:parse lets an AQL author DEFINE a parser and register it as a `parse`
# kind (aql:parselang). A grammar is built from an ABNF source (Parse.abnf),
# declarative rules (Parse.rule, shaped by the Parse.RuleSpec / Parse.AltSpec
# Map subtypes), fixed tokens (Parse.token) and custom lex matchers
# (Parse.matcher); semantic actions (Parse.action) attach AQL fns to grammar
# marks so the parser can emit custom data. Parse.grammar mints the builder;
# Parse.register finalizes it. The carrier is a shared pointer threaded
# through each word and bound to a def. Register-only: run via `parse <name>`.
# §1  ABNF grammar + a mark action — the action's AQL value is the result
import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [7])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc" / "dec"' {start:'op'}  Parse.register op g  end  parse op 'inc'
column3: Parse.grammar + Parse.action + Parse.abnf + Parse.register: action value is the AST

column1: import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [{k:'inc'}])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc" / "dec"' {start:'op'}  Parse.register opm g  end  (parse opm 'inc').k
column3: an action can build a custom Map node that survives to the parse result

column1: # §2  tokens, a declining matcher, and a declarative rule coexist with ABNF

import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.token g '#PL' '+'  Parse.matcher g skip 1000000 ([s:String] => [None])  Parse.rule g extra {open:[{s:'#PL'}]}  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [5])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc"' {start:'op'}  Parse.register op2 g  end  parse op2 'inc'
column3: Parse.token, a declining Parse.matcher and a declarative Parse.rule build alongside the ABNF grammar

column1: # §3  the grammar-as-Map-subtypes type exports
import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  typeof Parse.AltSpec
column3: Parse.AltSpec is a Map subtype describing one grammar alternate

column1: import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  typeof Parse.RuleSpec
column3: Parse.RuleSpec is a Map subtype describing a rule's open/close alternates

column1: # §4  loud failures (negative coverage)
import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.abnf g '= = bad ='  Parse.register broke g
column3: a malformed ABNF grammar is a loud error at register, not a panic

column3: an action ref must start with '@' (a mark/phase selector)

column1: import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.abnf g 'x = "a"' {start:'x'}  Parse.register json g
column3: registering a name that collides with a built-in parse kind is refused

column1: # §5  Parse.spec — the WHOLE grammar as one declarative map. Sections (all
#     optional): token:{name:literal}, matcher:{name:{priority fn}},
#     action:{'@ref': fn-or-list}, rule:{name:{open close}} (the Parse.rule
#     shape), abnf: String | {src +opts} | [entry…]. Sections apply in
#     dependency order (token, action, rule, abnf; matchers last at
#     register), so the map form is equivalent to — and composes with — the
#     chained builder words.

import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {action:{'@op:o:INC': ([nd:Any] => [7])} abnf:{src:'op = "inc" / "dec"' start:'op'}}  Parse.register sp1 g  end  parse sp1 'inc'
column3: the §1 grammar as ONE map — action + abnf sections

column1: import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {token:{'#PL':'+'} rule:{extra:{open:[{s:'#PL'}]}} action:{'@op:o:INC': ([nd:Any] => [5])} abnf:{src:'op = "inc"' start:'op'}}  Parse.register sp2 g  end  parse sp2 'inc'
column3: the §2 grammar as one map — token, declarative rule, action and abnf sections coexist

column1: import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def f1 ([nd:Any] => [3])  def f2 ([nd:Any] => [nd add 4])  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {action:{'@op:o:INC': [f1/r f2/r]} abnf:{src:'op = "inc"' start:'op'}}  Parse.register sp3 g  end  parse sp3 'inc'
column3: an action LIST runs in order, each fn seeing the previous one's node (/r keeps the fns inert in the list)

column1: import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {abnf:[{src:'op = "inc" / "dec"' start:'op'}]}  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [9])  Parse.register sp4 g  end  parse sp4 'inc'
column3: the abnf section takes a LIST of entries, and the map form composes with the chained builder words

column1: import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {matcher:{skip:{priority:1000000 fn:([s:String] => [None])}} action:{'@op:o:INC': ([nd:Any] => [2])} abnf:{src:'op = "inc"' start:'op'}}  Parse.register sp5 g  end  parse sp5 'inc'
column3: a declining custom matcher rides in the matcher section

column1: import "aql:parse"  import "aql:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {token:{'#PL':'+'} rule:{extra:{open:[{s:'#PL' c:{dlist:0} u:{tag:'t'} k:{p:'q'} n:{x:1}}]}} action:{'@op:o:INC': ([nd:Any] => [1])} abnf:{src:'op = "inc"' start:'op'}}  Parse.register sp6 g  end  parse sp6 'inc'
column3: the widened alternate fields — declarative condition c, custom props u/k, counters n — build and register cleanly
